theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ftl_compatible_automorphisms_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (hmono : Monotone F), (∀ x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ, ∃ i : ℕ, x ∈ F i) → ∀ g : (i : ℕ) → F i ≃ₐ[ℚ] F i, (∀ (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (x : F i), IntermediateField.inclusion (hmono hij) (g i x) = g j (IntermediateField.inclusion (hmono hij) x)) → ∃ τ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ, ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : F i), τ (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = ((g i x : F i) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
